title: Boosting Argument Quality
author: 652175ce9cd133611505f671
chapter_outcomes: Develop the ability to identify, select and apply appropriate information to respond to a task
Use information as evidence to support an argument with examples and to develop ideas
Develop the ability to analyse data, interpret information and offer key points
Apply information that exemplifies ideas and opinions
Develop explanations with examples, analysis and evaluation
Write a persuasive text that expresses an opinion and justifies a conclusion
Candidates are assessed on how clearly they communicate their response including: the range, accuracy and appropriateness of vocabulary and spelling, use of register, grammar and punctuation
